title: Mixed Event — Doll Festival at the Tenma's — Episode6 Where I Need To Go

meta.Episode: Episode6 — Where I Need To Go
meta.Event Outline: It's the first Doll Festival since Saki returned to school! In the midst of his enthusiastic preparations, Tsukasa looks back on a bitter childhood memory. He then executes his plan to do something special for Saki, but will it go as he hopes...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Under normal circumstances, I'd go straight home and get ready for the party but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just forget it! We're done talking, Tsukasa! At least until you remember what actually happened back then!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If Saki and I don't make up, her party won't go well at all either...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I want things to go smoothly for her sake...! This year's Doll Festival has to be the best she's ever experienced!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But if I were to just go now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What exactly am I forgetting too...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've wandered my way out to the gate...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That reminds me, everyone in SEKAI is putting on a Doll Festival party too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As long as I have nowhere else to go, it may be best for me to help them out at least...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It looks like Emu and the others aren't here yet...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Miku. I came to help with the party.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really?! Thanks☆ You're a lifesaver♪
Luka's putting up decorations over there so let's...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You don't look so good, Tsukasa. Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: N-No, of course I'm okay! I'm full of energy and ready to go like always!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Help Luka, right?
I'll head right over!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Luka! I'm here to help!
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She fell asleep while lining up the dolls...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Perfect timing. Could you help me with these dolls?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh, of course. I'll get right on it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe, thank you.
This one goes there...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right, the three court ladies go on the second row, and the one without the ornament of eternal youth goes in the middle.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Thank you for that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe. You can ask me anything when it comes to the Doll Festival!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You sure do know quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, where does this one go?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And she belongs at the very top...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... Please, excuse me...
I was just thinking about...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
If you don't mind, Tsukasa...
There's something I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Didn't you mention that your sister, Saki, is having a party today as well?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't have to be there with her?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I wish I could... But if I do, I'll ruin the mood and she won't be able to enjoy herself...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We had a fight this morning and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was sure that she'd like some new dolls to replace the old ones but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sigh*... I'll only end up making her mad by going home now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think it'd be worse if someone you cared about ended up not being there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In my case, I wouldn't be able to really enjoy a party if Miku and the others weren't there. Even if it were incredibly extravagant...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But when they are there, it's fun to just even sing together♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which is why I believe Saki needs you to be there at her party too♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm not happy at all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just forget it! We're done talking, Tsukasa! At least until you remember what actually happened back then!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, Nene. What's the matter?
You seem to be in a hurry...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Mochizuki is waiting by the gate.
She says it's urgent, so please go.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Could something have happened to Saki...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sorry, Luka! I know we're not done yet but...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's okay. Go♪
Make up with Saki and be there for her♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right! And thank you for hearing me out!
I'll see you later!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*... Why does he have to make such a big fuss over everything?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, since I'm here, I'll take Tsukasa's place and help you with the...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How can I calm down at a time like this?! You being here means something must've happened to Saki, right?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, yes this is about Saki but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Uh, well... Saki still feels really bad about that fight you had with her this morning.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki... I thought she was mad at me...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, she's not mad anymore. She feels awful about what she said to you earlier.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And she's been worried sick that you won't show up for the party.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I... I just wanted her to smile and be happy, but all I've done is...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, that can wait!
I have to go now...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Isn't it obvious?! To see Saki!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's go, Honami!
Let's find my beloved sister!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh...? W-Wait...!
P-Please wait for me!
